# Third-party components

- Embla Carousel 8.6.0, David Jerleke: https://github.com/davidjerleke/embla-carousel. MIT; see embla-LICENSE. Vendored browser distribution powers the rack drag and arrow navigation.
- Tabler Icons, hanger, Paweł Kuna: https://github.com/tabler/tabler-icons/blob/main/icons/outline/hanger.svg. MIT; see tabler-LICENSE. The path is inlined into rack garment hangers.

Application-specific garment placement and shelf styling are custom adaptations.
